U30LL0BZNdk16MtcdmJo.titulo: SEP and UNESCO present the framework for the national debate on technology, digital devices, and social media in schools
U30LL0BZNdk16MtcdmJo.descripcion: On July 20, 2026, the Secretaría de Educación Pública (Mexican Ministry of Public Education), together with UNESCO, presented the framework for the national debate on the use of technology, digital devices, and social media in schools. The document reports that 8 out of 10 students already use generative artificial intelligence (SEP, 2026), and 1 out of 11 young people use it for emotional support, guidance, or consultation; it warns about the risks of "empathetic" generative AI (the most empathetic models commit up to 30% more errors and are 40% more prone to validating the user; Ibrahim et al., 2026), cyberbullying (23% of school-age population; INEGI, 2024), and the substitution of human bonds. It places Mexico facing a global trend: 114 education systems—58% of countries—already regulate devices in schools (UNESCO/GEM, 2026), with three models (school autonomy with guidelines, phones outside the classroom, and phone-free schools) and models for regulating networks for minors (by age, by developmental stages, and by platform design). As next steps, the government announced the presentation of an initiative to the Congreso de la Unión (Mexican Congress), regional forums titled "Life Before the Screen" (August 19, Northeast/Nuevo León; September 3, South-Southeast/Chiapas; September 17, South-Center/Guerrero), and the National Week of Traditional Mexican Games. It includes a presentation by Dr. Cimenna Chao Rebolledo (Universidad Iberoamericana Mexico City) on mental health and technology, with preventive actions by sector (education, family, technology—platform design under the principle of "Care Ethics"—and academic). Official framing: "It is not a fight against technology, but rather in favor of learning and guaranteeing a full and happy childhood."
U30LL0BZNdk16MtcdmJo.resumenAgente: SEP–UNESCO framework for national debate on technology, devices, and networks in schools; announces initiative to Congreso de la Unión (Mexican Congress) and regional forums. Generative AI in 8 out of 10 students. Confidence: documented (official SEP presentation, July 20, 2026).

8zZCSnX8Je2oz8xYFsoA.titulo: SECIHTI presents 13 technological sovereignty projects (Olinia, Coatlicue, AI)
8zZCSnX8Je2oz8xYFsoA.descripcion: On July 1, 2026, Rosaura Ruiz Gutiérrez (SECIHTI) presented before joint committees of the Senate and Chamber of Deputies 13 strategic projects for technological development and innovation, with Olinia (Mexico's first domestically designed electric vehicle, production planned for 2027), the Coatlicue supercomputer, and the National Computing and AI Cluster (10 institutions) as main pillars. It includes a proposal for a regulatory framework for AI use in priority areas such as education, human rights, and ethical use.
8zZCSnX8Je2oz8xYFsoA.resumenAgente: Presentation to Congress. Confidence: documented. Includes AI regulatory framework proposal → connects to the federal legal framework of the National Plan.

vTTWeZ0Qfj3Fbnm7jl9m.descripcion: The Mexican government announced the development of a sovereign AI language model designed to recognize cultural expressions and approximately 70 indigenous languages nationwide, to counter biases in systems created by the U.S., China, or Europe. First results are estimated in around two years, accompanied by investment of approximately 9 billion dollars for the construction of data centers.
vTTWeZ0Qfj3Fbnm7jl9m.resumenAgente: Confidence: documented. Investment ~$9,000M in data centers; first results ~2 years. Promise to track.

x1MjilFk9oXShosDX083.titulo: National debate to regulate AI and social media (post-2026 World Cup)
x1MjilFk9oXShosDX083.descripcion: President Claudia Sheinbaum announced that, once the 2026 World Cup concludes (~July 19), the federal government will open a process of information and discussion on artificial intelligence and social media, with specialists invited to the morning briefing. The stated objective is to create regulatory conditions 'without falling into censorship', addressing ethical, educational, labor, and economic challenges posed by AI, as well as the use of mobile phones and social media among minors.
x1MjilFk9oXShosDX083.resumenAgente: Announced at the morning briefing (Jun 30, 2026). Confidence: documented (high-circulation press). Connects with the federal legal framework for AI under the National Plan.

JVCRwRvt93KF92KYUVsd.titulo: Presentation of the Sectoral Study 'Intelligent Mexico: Manufacturing Facing an Opportunity That Won't Wait'
JVCRwRvt93KF92KYUVsd.descripcion: The Secretaría de Economía (Ministry of Economy) released the first sectoral study on Artificial Intelligence adoption using INEGI (National Institute of Statistics and Geography) data, conducted by Centro México Digital (CMD) based on the Censo Económico 2024 (2024 Economic Census). The study reveals that Mexican manufacturing is in an early adoption phase for AI, with only 4.8% of manufacturing companies using it, but demonstrates measurable benefits: +18.8% increase in gross production and +5.4% increase in wages. It proposes 10 actions organized around three strategic axes to accelerate adoption.

mk3XmCXRG6iJhS5CZDKt.titulo: Evaluation Week 2026 - AI in Government Performance Evaluation
mk3XmCXRG6iJhS5CZDKt.descripcion: The Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno de Tamaulipas (Secretariat Against Corruption and Good Governance of Tamaulipas) inaugurated the second session of Evaluation Week 2026, focused on "Artificial Intelligence in Evaluation: Experiences in government performance evaluation in the era of Artificial Intelligence." The event analyzes how AI can strengthen evaluation processes in public administration.

r5Lng2xSJjlf4qMKRETY.titulo: AI System with Cameras for Accelerated Vehicle Verification
r5Lng2xSJjlf4qMKRETY.descripcion: The President announced the incorporation of artificial intelligence with cameras to expedite the vehicle verification process for vehicles in circulation. The system will be presented soon with the advances developed by the SICT (Secretaría de Infraestructura, Comunicaciones y Transportes).
r5Lng2xSJjlf4qMKRETY.resumenAgente: No estaba presente en el archivo original.

S7SwKz6rPGq4lHUBex6H.titulo: Mexico Calls on Iberoamerica to Lead in Data and AI Economy
S7SwKz6rPGq4lHUBex6H.descripcion: Secretary of Economy (Secretario de Economía) Marcelo Ebrard urged Iberoamerican countries to arrive 'on time' to the new data and artificial intelligence economy. He announced that Mexico is developing Spanish-language AI capabilities and a Mexican supercomputer linked to Barcelona's.

tQOf0YWBCp0oJLMHDWks.titulo: Karla - First AI Assistant Integrated into Municipal Government
tQOf0YWBCp0oJLMHDWks.descripcion: The Municipality of Querétaro unveiled Karla, the first artificial intelligence assistant formally integrated into a municipal government's operations in Mexico. The tool is part of the municipality's digital strategy alongside App Ciudad and its single-window administrative service.

28O08kXmWTHpvJRXEjpb.titulo: Second Call for the Public Center for Artificial Intelligence Training - 30,000 Spots
28O08kXmWTHpvJRXEjpb.descripcion: The Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (Digital Transformation and Telecommunications Agency) launched the second national call for free artificial intelligence training with 30,000 available spots, tripling the capacity of the first generation, which was 10,000 students. Update (16-jun-2026): the 2nd generation opened with 30,000 spots; the 1st generation was 10,000 students and the goal is 25,000 certificates/year, with 14 allied companies (gob.mx/atdt; La Jornada, 26-may-2026).

TfQzMmZ85J1CuJIBpvWG.titulo: Application with AI for the Servicio Universal de Salud (Universal Health Service)
TfQzMmZ85J1CuJIBpvWG.descripcion: President Claudia Sheinbaum announced the development of an application for the Servicio Universal de Salud (Universal Health Service) with artificial intelligence support for various uses that would benefit citizens enrolled in the system. It has been designed for some time to complement the digital credential of the health service.

atdt-centro-ia-2da-convocatoria-2026-05-.titulo: ATDT: 2nd Call for the Centro Público de Formación en Inteligencia Artificial (Public Center for AI Training) — 30,000 Free Spots
atdt-centro-ia-2da-convocatoria-2026-05-.descripcion: On May 26, 2026, the Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT, Digital Transformation and Telecommunications Agency) launched the second national call for the Centro Público de Formación en Inteligencia Artificial (Public Center for AI Training). The program offers 30,000 free spots in online format, with a five-month duration. Courses include cloud technologies, applied AI, 5G cybersecurity, intelligent agent development, image segmentation with advanced models, and AI fundamentals. Registration is open from May 26 to July 5, 2026 at mexia.gob.mx. This is a continuation of the Centro Público de Formación en Inteligencia Artificial whose first cohort began in January 2026.

R6DyxgGCVLpSEaB8PbOi.titulo: Proposal to Regulate AI in Elections
R6DyxgGCVLpSEaB8PbOi.descripcion: Federal Deputy Ernesto Sánchez Rodríguez (PAN) presented a reform initiative to sanction the improper use of artificial intelligence in electoral processes, amending the Ley General de Instituciones y Procedimientos Electorales (General Law on Electoral Institutions and Procedures) to classify improper use of AI systems as an electoral infraction.

aqMZoDLT1FiucG4axTJG.titulo: Smart Operating Room IMSS-Bienestar (Mexican Social Security Welfare Institute) - First Public Hospital with Integrated AI Technology
aqMZoDLT1FiucG4axTJG.descripcion: The first smart operating room of IMSS-Bienestar was inaugurated at Hospital General de Jiutepec, Morelos. This technology integrates high-resolution screens, robotic arms, advanced digital systems, and telemedicine capabilities that allow surgical procedures to be performed with remote connection to specialists from different parts of the country. The operating room features an advanced anesthesia machine, vital signs monitoring, and real-time transmission capacity.

EWG6WoeBa1kWsDQThHqU.titulo: UNAM Creates the Consejo Coordinador de Inteligencia Artificial (CCOIA, Coordinating Board for Artificial Intelligence)
EWG6WoeBa1kWsDQThHqU.descripcion: By agreement of Rector Leonardo Lomelí Vanegas, UNAM created (March 17, 2026, bulletin UNAM-DGCS-155) and formally installed (May 18, 2026, bulletin UNAM-DGCS-294) the Consejo Coordinador de Inteligencia Artificial (CCOIA, Coordinating Board for Artificial Intelligence): a strategic, high-level body to coordinate the university's institutional capabilities in the field of AI. Its mandate includes setting directives and cross-cutting policies, establishing ethical standards for responsible use, safeguarding academic integrity and intellectual property, and promoting innovation in teaching and research, with a humanistic perspective adapted to Mexico and Latin America's social, linguistic, and economic realities. The Board is presided over by the Rector; its coordinator (operational head) is Lic. Pablo Pruneda Gross, from the Línea de Investigación Institucional en Derecho e Inteligencia Artificial (LIDIA, Institutional Research Line in Law and Artificial Intelligence) of the Instituto de Investigaciones Jurídicas (IIJ, Institute of Legal Research). It is supported by an Comité Académico Interdisciplinario (CAI, Interdisciplinary Academic Committee) as a technical body for permanent consultation and advisory services. It positions Mexico's largest public university as an academic actor that sets governance, ethical, and regulatory criteria for AI with relevance to Mexican government public policies.
EWG6WoeBa1kWsDQThHqU.resumenAgente: UNAM's university body for AI governance, presided over by the Rector and coordinated by Pablo Pruneda Gross. Confidence: documented (bulletins UNAM-DGCS-155 and DGCS-294, UNAM Official Gazette).

dof-lft-lfda-ia-artistas-2026-05-14.titulo: DOF: Reform to LFT (Federal Labor Law) and LFDA (Federal Copyright Law) — Mexico's First Binding AI Regulation Restricting Voice and Image Cloning for Artists
dof-lft-lfda-ia-artistas-2026-05-14.descripcion: On May 14, 2026, the Official Gazette of the Federation (Diario Oficial de la Federación, DOF) published a decree reforming and adding various provisions to the Federal Labor Law (Ley Federal del Trabajo, LFT) and the Federal Copyright Law (Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor, LFDA), regarding the rights of artist workers, performers, or entertainers. It is the first binding AI regulation published in Mexico. It requires that contracts specify conditions regarding AI use and compensation when voice or image is processed by generative systems. The LFDA extends voice and image protection to cover outputs generated by AI systems, prohibits cloning or impersonation that induces error or substitutes for professional performance, and requires prior written consent. Exceptions apply for parody, satire, or creative imitation that does not substitute for the artist. Penalties up to 40,000 days of wages.

8qBQoDh69J8BnNdrC1rO.titulo: Austribot Project - Virtual Assistant for the Embassy of Mexico in Austria
8qBQoDh69J8BnNdrC1rO.descripcion: Students from the Universidad Tecnológica de Cancún (Cancún Technological University) developed and officially delivered the Austribot project to the Embassy of Mexico in Austria. It is a virtual assistance platform based on artificial intelligence to support Mexicans traveling to or residing in Austria, Slovakia, and Slovenia, operating 24 hours a day to provide information on consular services.

2ulSAPZNSHk4cWwa2OwQ.titulo: Primera Ley Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial del Senado (First National Artificial Intelligence Law from the Senate) - Final Version
2ulSAPZNSHk4cWwa2OwQ.descripcion: The Senado (Mexican Senate) presented the final version of Mexico's first Ley de Inteligencia Artificial (Artificial Intelligence Law) after 10 months of multipartisan work, establishing criminal penalties for AI misuse and creating new specialized authorities

fabrica-ia-supercomputadora-mexico-2026-.titulo: Announcement: Mexico's First AI Factory — Latin America's Most Powerful Supercomputer
fabrica-ia-supercomputadora-mexico-2026-.descripcion: On May 5, 2026, the federal government announced the construction of Mexico's First AI Factory, which would house the most powerful supercomputer in Latin America, aimed at supporting public research projects, sovereign AI models, and high-performance computing services for government and academia. Announcement aligned with the Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT - Agency for Digital Transformation and Telecommunications) and the Centro Público de Formación en IA (Public AI Training Center). Status: in development, with no confirmed date for public operation.

IXc5XosAVQFO5XRCHBc7.titulo: AI in the Judicial Power (Poder Judicial) of the State of Mexico
IXc5XosAVQFO5XRCHBc7.descripcion: Mexico State's Judicial Power (Poder Judicial) has announced advances in the development and deployment of artificial intelligence tools designed to reduce court workloads and accelerate citizen services. The technology is already being used for victim assistance and risk assessment, with the goal of strengthening conflict resolution.

QIMKAX4Oo2uCVWc6ExL9.titulo: New Regulatory Framework of the Comisión de Ciencia y Tecnología del Senado (Senate Commission on Science and Technology) for Artificial Intelligence
QIMKAX4Oo2uCVWc6ExL9.descripcion: The Comisión de Ciencia y Tecnología del Senado (Senate Commission on Science and Technology) presents a new legislative proposal to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in Mexico, establishing safeguards for human rights, privacy, and personal data protection. The initiative seeks to promote technological innovation while ensuring legal certainty, adapting legislation in health, education, and digital divides.

sonia-ia-sentencias-queretaro-2026.titulo: SonIA System — Generative AI for Drafting Court Rulings (Poder Judicial de Querétaro)
sonia-ia-sentencias-queretaro-2026.descripcion: For the first time in Mexico, the Tribunal de Querétaro (Querétaro Court) used its generative AI system 'SonIA' to help draft two final court rulings: a divorcio incausado (no-fault divorce) and a juicio ejecutivo mercantil (commercial execution proceeding). The system was developed with an investment of 17 million pesos and operates under ethical guidelines established in October 2025.

QNx83A2A0NwfjXqzZocT.titulo: Legislative Framework for AI in Government Procedures of the State of Mexico
QNx83A2A0NwfjXqzZocT.descripcion: The Congreso del Estado de México (Congress of the State of Mexico) is developing an initiative to regulate artificial intelligence in the state and municipal public sector, with two main pillars: ethical use of AI on digital platforms and incorporation into administrative procedures. Changes would include AI-enabled government service windows and an operational framework for residents of the State of Mexico.

hTPUwTzbgmEXlJZBjqTf.titulo: Flex's USD $1 Billion Investment in AI Data Centers
hTPUwTzbgmEXlJZBjqTf.descripcion: The Secretaría de Economía (Ministry of Economy) announced a one-billion-dollar investment by Flex Corporation between 2026 and 2028 to develop data centers and advanced manufacturing of artificial intelligence equipment. The investment will generate more than 5,000 direct jobs in Guadalajara, Aguascalientes, and Ciudad Juárez, adding to the company's existing 40,000 jobs in Mexico.

ZEGW3VXLIlfOhkMbnwVz.titulo: First Plant Without Employees with AI in Nuevo León
ZEGW3VXLIlfOhkMbnwVz.descripcion: Mexico is heading toward a new industrial phase with the introduction of its first fully automated plant, called a 'dark factory'. This system, which operates without direct human intervention, already has its location planned in Nuevo León to manufacture home appliances with artificial intelligence and could begin operations in 2027.

tmaruF5esANCkvQELvke.titulo: National Seminar on 'Artificial Intelligence for National Development'
tmaruF5esANCkvQELvke.descripcion: The Senate of Mexico (Senado de México) inaugurated the National Seminar on 'Artificial Intelligence for National Development', as part of the activities of the Commission for Analysis, Monitoring, and Assessment of the Application and Development of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico.

4dwoqnRwCPVBEXAUzjlj.titulo: Graph-Based Model to Combat Fraudulent Invoicing (EFOS/EDOS)
4dwoqnRwCPVBEXAUzjlj.descripcion: Analytical system from the SAT's AI Factory that represents taxpayers and transactions as a large-scale graph (art. 69-B of the Código Fiscal de la Federación, Federal Tax Code) to identify networks of fraudulent invoicing and strengthen auditing and tax enforcement.
4dwoqnRwCPVBEXAUzjlj.resumenAgente: AI Factory, Plan Nacional de IA (National AI Plan) p.20-21. Confidence: official.

5rKbmc7zy4qdWH4TLLyU.descripcion: Central node of the national data centers network of the State; received a USD 7 million investment to expand its operational capacity and extend services to multiple federal public institutions.
5rKbmc7zy4qdWH4TLLyU.resumenAgente: National AI Plan (Plan Nacional de IA) p.23. Investment USD 7M. Confidence: official.

BoVGGdMoFh24J4vTKzyL.titulo: Plan Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (National Artificial Intelligence Plan)
BoVGGdMoFh24J4vTKzyL.descripcion: The ATDT published in April 2026 Mexico's first National Artificial Intelligence Plan: a State strategy built on three pillars (ethical and legal framework; capabilities, talent, and public software; and strategic infrastructure for technological sovereignty). It encompasses the Principios de Chapultepec (Chapultepec Principles), the Centro Público de Formación en IA (Public Center for AI Training), the Fábrica de IA (AI Factory), and the Coatlicue supercomputer.
BoVGGdMoFh24J4vTKzyL.resumenAgente: Official document (April 2026, 28 pp). Confidence: official. Anchor of the promise-vs-fulfillment tracker.

HB4b3V1hQd3BhEbYnrJl.descripcion: Multimodal tool from the Fábrica de IA (AI Factory) that integrates text reports, images, and voice notes to consolidate in real-time the status of missing, hospitalized, or deceased persons during emergencies.
HB4b3V1hQd3BhEbYnrJl.resumenAgente: Fábrica de IA (AI Factory), National AI Plan (Plan Nacional de IA) p.21. Confidence: official.

JZz68T2TilIvXZEKpL4M.descripcion: Tool developed by the Fábrica de IA (Mexico's AI Factory) for the Agencia Nacional de Aduanas (National Customs Agency, ANAM) that prioritizes inspections based on historical data and institutional criteria, directing customs reviews toward cases with the highest violation risk.
JZz68T2TilIvXZEKpL4M.resumenAgente: Fábrica de IA (Mexico's AI Factory), National AI Plan (Plan Nacional de IA) p.18. Trust: official.

YHv8ANzsH6LJTjir1KBp.descripcion: Data center undergoing enablement that will incorporate large-scale computing, massive storage, and high-capacity connectivity as part of the State's national data center network.
YHv8ANzsH6LJTjir1KBp.resumenAgente: Plan Nacional de IA (National AI Plan) p.23. Confidence: official.

bZKL6lZqAYyXWAAZt4aH.titulo: Kuúl — AI-powered tourist assistant (Spanish and English)
bZKL6lZqAYyXWAAZt4aH.descripcion: Conversational agent from the Fábrica de IA (Mexico's AI Lab) for the Secretaría de Turismo (Ministry of Tourism) that recommends destinations based on the official database of tourist sites, operating in Spanish and English.
bZKL6lZqAYyXWAAZt4aH.resumenAgente: Fábrica de IA (AI Lab), Plan Nacional de IA (National AI Plan) p.19. Confidence: official.

lc5TqNoGFynhHfyR5x1z.titulo: OCR and Patent Classification with AI
lc5TqNoGFynhHfyR5x1z.descripcion: Platform of the AI Factory (Fábrica de IA) for the IMPI (Mexican Institute of Industrial Property) that digitizes patent documents, automates their classification (CIP), and enables advanced searches to support technical and legal examination.
lc5TqNoGFynhHfyR5x1z.resumenAgente: AI Factory (Fábrica de IA), National AI Plan (Plan Nacional de IA) p.20. Confidence: official.

zf8eBld3saGhqP1VbSXR.titulo: Coatlicue — commitment to begin construction in Zacatenco (project ANU-2025-010)
zf8eBld3saGhqP1VbSXR.descripcion: Start of construction of the 'Coatlicue' supercomputer on the Zacatenco campus of the IPN (Instituto Politécnico Nacional), with an investment of 6 billion pesos. It will be the most powerful in Latin America with a capacity of 314 petaflops (~314 trillion operations per second), designed to process government data, climate models, and support the AI Factory (Fábrica de IA). Update (June 16, 2026): the Technical Committee was installed (June 5) and the Zacatenco IPN headquarters was confirmed, in collaboration with the Barcelona Supercomputing Center. ⚠ Discrepancy: the official Plan sets the groundbreaking in June; the press places it in August 2026.

B9KKqkc47A5vxKTkx84Q.titulo: Rector's Agreement: UNAM Institutes the Artificial Intelligence Coordinating Council (CCOIA)
B9KKqkc47A5vxKTkx84Q.descripcion: On March 17, 2026 (UNAM-DGCS-155 bulletin), by agreement of Rector Leonardo Lomelí Vanegas, UNAM formally established the Artificial Intelligence Coordinating Council (Consejo Coordinador de Inteligencia Artificial, CCOIA) as a high-level strategic body to coordinate the university's capabilities in artificial intelligence: establishing directives and cross-cutting policies, ethical standards for responsible use, safeguarding academic integrity and intellectual property, and fostering innovation in teaching and research with a humanistic perspective. The agreement defines its structure around three pillars—education, scientific research, and modernization of internal processes—and creates an Interdisciplinary Academic Committee (Comité Académico Interdisciplinario, CAI) as a permanent technical body. The Council was formally installed on May 18, 2026, with the designation of Lic. Pablo Pruneda Gross as coordinator. It represents the institutional artificial intelligence policy of the country's largest public university, with direct relevance for regulatory debate and public policy discussions in Mexico.
B9KKqkc47A5vxKTkx84Q.resumenAgente: Rector's agreement establishing UNAM's AI governance body (CCOIA). Confidence: documented (UNAM-DGCS-155 bulletin, Gaceta UNAM (UNAM Gazette)).

MX7HbOsL0jpHtYotz7js.titulo: Citizen Projects Program - Federal Venture Capital Support for AI Startups
MX7HbOsL0jpHtYotz7js.descripcion: The federal government announced venture capital support for high-impact technology innovation projects including artificial intelligence, as part of the Plan México (National Development Plan). The program includes a Fund of Funds capitalized at 4 billion pesos to support startups and companies developing viable AI and emerging technology projects.

NCTyktjwd049wmfMpVCZ.titulo: Programa Proyectos Ciudadanos (Citizen Projects Program) - Financing for Artificial Intelligence Startups
NCTyktjwd049wmfMpVCZ.descripcion: The federal government launched the Programa Proyectos Ciudadanos (Citizen Projects Program) of the Impulsora de Innovación México (Mexico's Innovation Promoter), which will finance high-impact technological initiatives, including artificial intelligence projects, with a capitalization of 4 billion pesos through the relaunching of the Fondo de Fondos (Fund of Funds). The program seeks to support Mexican companies with high innovation capacity but limited access to external financing, offering temporary venture capital to accelerate strategic projects in areas such as semiconductors, biotechnology, drones, healthcare, and specifically artificial intelligence and advanced data.

4I73WZ0NTQYsm4fa1L6Z.descripcion: BUAP established itself as the first higher education institution in Mexico to integrate an artificial intelligence model into its digital library system. The 'Alma BUAP' system provides access to over 500,000 books and 165 research platforms with 90% precision. It filters information overload, formulates questions to define research strategy, and maintains personalized search history.
4I73WZ0NTQYsm4fa1L6Z.resumenAgente: Traducción ES→EN completada. Dos campos traducidos (titulo, descripcion). Nombres propios (BUAP, Alma BUAP, México) conservados sin traducción. Tono periodístico Reuters/Economist para lectores de política mexicana en inglés.

PR9LNaLkrIYclJvM4fjl.descripcion: Artificial Vision for Industrial Inspection workshop as part of a strategic partnership between the Universidad Politécnica de Yucatán (Yucatán Polytechnic University) and NVIDIA to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the UPY. Students from the Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence programs participated. Alberto Muñoz, NVIDIA Ambassador, delivered the inaugural conference focused on automation and industrial supervision with advanced algorithms.

XtbjzN6rqVVNxFua8W3p.titulo: 'Digital Rights and Artificial Intelligence' Working Group of Mexico City
XtbjzN6rqVVNxFua8W3p.descripcion: The Secretaría de Educación, Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Secretary of Education, Science, Technology and Innovation) of Mexico City, together with the Agencia Digital de Innovación Pública (Public Digital Innovation Agency), officially established the Digital Rights and Artificial Intelligence Working Group to generate ideas and proposals ensuring ethical and equitable use of AI for the benefit of the citizenry. Government applications are expected in water management, public security, health, and other services.

CmrTElBFBw2gOFHrdk7x.titulo: Monterrey-AIFOD Agreement for AI Hub in LATAM
CmrTElBFBw2gOFHrdk7x.descripcion: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between Monterrey and the AI for Developing Countries Forum (AIFOD) during the AIFOD Bangkok Summit. Positions Monterrey as a strategic AI hub for sustainable development in Latin America. Frameworks for joint research, knowledge exchange, and talent development.
CmrTElBFBw2gOFHrdk7x.resumenAgente: On February 4, 2026, the Monterrey Municipal Government signed an MOU with AIFOD during the Bangkok Summit at the UN ESCAP Hall. The agreement positions Monterrey as an AI hub for sustainable development in LATAM, with frameworks for joint research in smart cities, energy, and agriculture. It is a proactive subnational initiative for international cooperation.

w93peJYN7GtnpVr1UJBA.titulo: Call for Teacher Training in AI - Chihuahua
w93peJYN7GtnpVr1UJBA.descripcion: Teacher training initiative in digital tools, including Artificial Intelligence, Google Forms, and WhatsApp Business, organized by the Secretaría de Educación y Deporte (Chihuahua State Department of Education and Sports), Servicios Educativos del Estado de Chihuahua (Chihuahua Educational Services), and the Coordinación Estatal de Tecnología Educativa (State Coordination of Educational Technology). Courses are free, offered online via Google Meet, and aimed at teaching staff in Chihuahua during February 2026.

10xPPv4q8gGDbDQM3rJi.titulo: Initiative to Regulate AI in the Dubbing Industry - Ready for Presidential Announcement
10xPPv4q8gGDbDQM3rJi.descripcion: The Secretaría de Cultura (Ministry of Culture) confirms that an initiative to regulate the use of Artificial Intelligence in film and television dubbing is now ready, aimed at protecting the work of voice actors and actresses. The proposal was built jointly with the dubbing industry guild, the Consejería Jurídica del Ejecutivo (Executive Legal Counsel), and various cultural communities.

yBOOKhll7NCW2oCvZjde.titulo: AI Regulation in the Dubbing Industry
yBOOKhll7NCW2oCvZjde.descripcion: Legislative initiative ready to be presented by the Presidency to protect voice actors against AI use. Built in agreement with the dubbing community. Part of a broader package of cultural initiatives including the Nueva Ley de Cine (New Cinema Law).
yBOOKhll7NCW2oCvZjde.resumenAgente: On February 3, 2026, Secretaría de Cultura (Ministry of Culture) head Claudia Curiel de Icaza announced a legislative initiative to protect the image and voice rights of voice actors against AI use. The proposal was built in agreement with the dubbing community and is part of the future Nueva Ley de Cine (New Cinema Law). It is a novel regulatory movement that addresses a specific niche of AI application in creative industries.

6mkzdm2XyTNSVkz5XzZR.titulo: AI Regulation in Political Campaigns (Electoral Reform)
6mkzdm2XyTNSVkz5XzZR.descripcion: The upcoming Electoral Reform (Reforma Electoral) will include a specific section regulating AI use in political campaigns. It aims to address the manipulation of multimedia content (images, videos, and voice) for disinformation. Draft under review.
6mkzdm2XyTNSVkz5XzZR.resumenAgente: On January 31, 2026, it was announced that the upcoming Electoral Reform (Reforma Electoral) will include specific regulation on AI use in political campaigns, focusing on combating multimedia content manipulation for disinformation. The proposal is driven by the Presidential Commission for Electoral Reform (Comisión Presidencial para la Reforma Electoral) and its formal presentation is expected in February 2026.

Aoq8rFjRaXu9VNcvBjtC.titulo: Artificial Intelligence Factory - Team of 100 Government Specialists
Aoq8rFjRaXu9VNcvBjtC.descripcion: Creation of Mexico's first Artificial Intelligence Factory, consisting of a team of one hundred specialists tasked with developing intelligent software and proprietary technological solutions for the public administration. The initiative seeks for the State to stop depending on external providers and develop digital tools tailored to the country's needs.

PI3rFlJJSduDJPVdX1ve.descripcion: Registrations open for new master's in Artificial Intelligence and Knowledge Engineering at Women's University of Chihuahua. 20-month program designed to train women in high-demand technology fields. Independent local initiative from federal programs.
PI3rFlJJSduDJPVdX1ve.resumenAgente: On January 30, 2026, the Chihuahua Municipal Government opened registrations for a master's in AI at Women's University. 20-month program focused on gender equity in computing and AI fields.

idnxPLkEj5uLOmaCYUQn.titulo: Chapultepec Principles - Declaration of Ethics and Best Practices for the Use and Development of Artificial Intelligence
idnxPLkEj5uLOmaCYUQn.descripcion: The Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (SECIHTI - Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation) and the Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT - Digital Transformation and Telecommunications Agency) officially presented the 'Chapultepec Principles,' a ten-point declaration of ethical guidelines for the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico. The principles establish that AI must expand rights, never restrict them; that every decision must have responsible human stewards; and that if a decision cannot be explained, it should not be automated. The declaration aims to guide public policies and institutional regulations related to AI adoption.

XTd3LYxcW1Xv4o6lvFi5.descripcion: BUAP announced the creation of the Agencia de Inteligencia Artificial Especializada (Specialized Artificial Intelligence Agency) to develop its own AI model, engage in ethical debate, and advance technological governance. It positions itself as the third institution in Mexico to launch development of its own AI model, following Tecnológico de Monterrey and UNAM. The agency focuses on ethics, data sovereignty, and training the next generation.

PdATpLSwb0gUJNN14rUT.descripcion: Training program "Artificial Intelligence: Uses and Criteria at the INE" targeted at all institute staff. First autonomous body in Mexico to actively regulate AI use within its sphere of operations.
PdATpLSwb0gUJNN14rUT.resumenAgente: On January 23, 2026, the INE launched its AI training program to consolidate the ethical and strategic use of technology in internal and electoral processes.

tGEqr3QIKmN1r37mE5Uw.titulo: AI System for Undergraduate Entrance Exam - UNAM
tGEqr3QIKmN1r37mE5Uw.descripcion: UNAM (National Autonomous University of Mexico) implemented an Artificial Intelligence system to monitor undergraduate entrance exams conducted online. The system integrates eye-tracking, automatic browser blocking, and real-time anomaly detection through AI algorithms. The Proctorizer tool is used as an AI-based remote proctoring system.

3dDaBvmtQLhu211hu2Vk.titulo: Mexico-Germany Cooperation with a Focus on AI
3dDaBvmtQLhu211hu2Vk.descripcion: 2026-2027 Work Plan between the Secretaría de Economía (Ministry of Economy) and Germany's Ministerio Federal de Economía y Energía (Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy). One of four strategic pillars is "Artificial intelligence: good regulatory practices and its practical application".
3dDaBvmtQLhu211hu2Vk.resumenAgente: On January 22, 2026, the Secretaría de Economía (Ministry of Economy) signed the 2026-2027 Work Plan with Germany, which includes AI as one of its four strategic pillars. Collaboration supported by the GIZ (German International Cooperation) and aligned with Plan Mexico.

Zbwt3cBpaA5vr0wcwLZ1.titulo: Forensic AI Tools for Missing Persons Search (IdentIA / ContextIA, Lab-Co)
Zbwt3cBpaA5vr0wcwLZ1.descripcion: IdentIA (tattoo recognition) and ContextIA (investigation file analysis via Retrieval-Augmented Generation) are forensic tools from Lab-Co, part of a missing persons search project funded by the European Union and the British Embassy. Incorporated in Feb 2026 in Jalisco and under implementation in other states. NOTE: the specific collaboration COESPO Guerrero / UAEM / UAGro attributed by the original record is not verified.
Zbwt3cBpaA5vr0wcwLZ1.resumenAgente: On January 22, 2026, the Guerrero State Government formalized a collaboration with UAEM and UAGro to use AI in locating missing persons, employing tools such as IdentIA and RAG.

Xa4zYxHO8cEvPGWEHima.titulo: Nexus AI Security System (State of Mexico)
Xa4zYxHO8cEvPGWEHima.descripcion: AI-based security platform for the 2026 World Cup. Real-time facial and vehicle recognition integrated with national databases. Initial infrastructure: 5,000 smart cameras and 111 highway checkpoints across 38 municipalities, expanding to 30,000 cameras by May 2026.
Xa4zYxHO8cEvPGWEHima.resumenAgente: On January 20, 2026, the State of Mexico Government unveiled the Nexus System, an AI-powered security platform for the 2026 World Cup. It features real-time facial and vehicle recognition with 5,000 smart cameras and 111 highway checkpoints. Operations scheduled to begin in April 2026.

YYSNrvK2yx1cAgkJZaLb.titulo: State Artificial Intelligence Laboratory of Nuevo León
YYSNrvK2yx1cAgkJZaLb.descripcion: Initiative to reform the Ley de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación del Estado de Nuevo León (State Science, Technology and Innovation Law) to establish the State Artificial Intelligence Laboratory as a specialized technical body. Seeks to transform Nuevo León from a technology consumer into a developer of sovereign AI solutions, aligning with national science policy.

FOa9pLneP2SogHrrRF0s.descripcion: Secihti inaugurated a permanent lecture series in AI to position artificial intelligence and high-performance computing as strategic axes for national development. Framed within the National Network for AI and High-Performance Computing.
FOa9pLneP2SogHrrRF0s.resumenAgente: On January 18, 2026, Secihti inaugurated a permanent lecture series in AI. The first session covered multi-objective evolutionary algorithms, delivered by Dr. Carlos Artemio Coello Coello from Cinvestav.

NJZXx6c09NLvp4L6cEp2.titulo: Initiative to Reform the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales (Federal Personal Data Protection Law) to Regulate AI Use
NJZXx6c09NLvp4L6cEp2.descripcion: Morena's parliamentary group in the Cámara de Diputados (Chamber of Deputies) introduced an initiative to reform the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Federal Personal Data Protection Law), with the aim of establishing clear rules for the use of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico and closing legal gaps in data protection.

S1ltSqWuEBViuJtJwfAR.titulo: Reform of the Ley General de Salud (General Health Law) - Digital Health with AI
S1ltSqWuEBViuJtJwfAR.descripcion: Reform published in the Diario Oficial de la Federación (Federal Official Gazette) creating Chapter VI BIS on Digital Health. Article 71 Ter explicitly recognizes the use of Artificial Intelligence and Big Data analysis to identify patterns, optimize diagnoses, personalize treatments, and improve hospital management. 180-day deadline for issuance of secondary regulations. [Precision: Chapter VI BIS (Articles 71 Bis–71 Septies) defines digital health but does NOT explicitly mention AI; the explicit recognition of AI/Big Data corresponds to Chapter VI Ter (Article 71 Nonies and following) of a subsequent reform.]

eASGGIzp0eGqtzGoC39H.titulo: AI Software for Lung Cancer Detection (INER)
eASGGIzp0eGqtzGoC39H.descripcion: INER implemented AI software to support early detection of lung cancer and respiratory diseases. Developed in collaboration with AstraZeneca. It integrates with the hospital's image management system to analyze chest radiographs.
eASGGIzp0eGqtzGoC39H.resumenAgente: INER implemented AI software with AstraZeneca for early detection of lung cancer, analyzing chest radiographs and upcoming CT scans.

HzpBLX3Mai2ihnHIk97O.descripcion: The Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas (Autonomous University of Tamaulipas) announced the establishment of its Artificial Intelligence Institute, approving the Manifiesto Institucional para el Uso Ético de la IA (Institutional Manifesto for Ethical AI Use). It will coordinate AI capabilities for teaching, research, and administration.
HzpBLX3Mai2ihnHIk97O.resumenAgente: On January 14, 2026, the UAT announced advances for its AI Institute. The Manifiesto Institucional para el Uso Ético de la IA (Institutional Manifesto for Ethical AI Use) was approved.

FVSklDJl2WqtFIHveuMx.titulo: Launching Ventanilla 24/7 - Government AI Virtual Assistant
FVSklDJl2WqtFIHveuMx.descripcion: Launch of the 'Ventanilla 24/7' virtual assistant, developed by the Fábrica de IA (AI Factory) to enable citizens to find federal administrative procedures on gob.mx using natural language. As of April 24, 2026, the tool had processed more than 1 million queries (649,783 through the virtual assistant and the remainder through 079 (government assistance line) operators), with a projection of 100,000 daily interactions by September 2026. Update (June 16, 2026): exceeded 280,000 users since its launch (January 9, 2026) (Infobea, June 13, 2026).

q3jTp0TQNrJRkiSuvD5F.titulo: Massive AI Training for Public Servants (Guanajuato)
q3jTp0TQNrJRkiSuvD5F.descripcion: Over 6,000 Guanajuato government officials trained in Generative AI as part of the Guanajuato Digital strategy, in partnership with Microsoft and the Cybersecurity Network. Recognized as the largest national reach for this type of training.
q3jTp0TQNrJRkiSuvD5F.resumenAgente: Guanajuato trained over 6,000 government officials in Generative AI with Microsoft, earning recognition for the largest national reach.

d4oN5CxiJp7Vql8GcXSa.titulo: Constitutional Reform Initiative to Empower Congress to Legislate on Artificial Intelligence
d4oN5CxiJp7Vql8GcXSa.descripcion: Deputy Hugo Gutiérrez Arroyo (PRI) presented a constitutional reform to Article 6 of the Constitución (Mexican Constitution) to empower the Congreso de la Unión (Mexican Congress) to legislate specifically on Artificial Intelligence. The proposal seeks to establish the legal foundations necessary to regulate this technology in the country.

BmUuyXqiBrWIi29aTS0g.titulo: Forensic AI Software - IdentIA and RAG (Person Search)
BmUuyXqiBrWIi29aTS0g.descripcion: Forensic AI tools developed by LAB-CO in collaboration with fiscalías (prosecutors' offices) in Zacatecas, Quintana Roo, Chiapas, and Jalisco. IdentIA specializes in tattoo recognition, RAG analyzes massive expedientes (case files). Exit from experimental phase scheduled for February 2026.
BmUuyXqiBrWIi29aTS0g.resumenAgente: Two forensic AI tools for missing persons: IdentIA (tattoos) and RAG (expediente analysis). Developed by LAB-CO with state fiscalías (prosecutors' offices). Will exit the experimental phase in February 2026.

JCaTP1cQ6HfT5GQbGP4p.titulo: 15 High School Programs in Artificial Intelligence
JCaTP1cQ6HfT5GQbGP4p.descripcion: Actively under implementation. New CBTIS (Centros de Bachillerato Tecnológico Industrial y de Servicios, Technical High Schools for Industry and Services) and CETIS (Centros de Estudios Tecnológicos Industriales y de Servicios, Centers for Industrial and Technical Studies) campuses offering AI programs have opened in Nuevo León, San Luis Potosí, Tijuana, Hidalgo, and Estado de México. CBTIS 299 (García, Nuevo León) and UNRC (San Luis Potosí) are already operating AI Engineering degrees.
JCaTP1cQ6HfT5GQbGP4p.resumenAgente: On December 1, 2025, Mexico's SEP (Secretaría de Educación Pública) unveiled a historic overhaul of the Bachillerato Nacional (National Baccalaureate Program), introducing 15 new technical degrees in innovation and technological development. Featured programs include artificial intelligence, robotics and automation, semiconductors, cybersecurity, business intelligence, and sustainable urban development. Implementation begins in the 2026 school year at public institutions nationwide. The initiative responds to both student demand for strategic sectors and Mexico's effort to strengthen national development in emerging technology fields.

iGa4PLrj1cBxo6hFtxqt.titulo: InnovaTecNM Fund - Financing for Technological Innovation Projects
iGa4PLrj1cBxo6hFtxqt.descripcion: President Claudia Sheinbaum announced the creation of the InnovaTecNM Fund, a financing mechanism designed to select and support technology projects developed by students of the Tecnológico Nacional de México (National Technology Institute of Mexico, TecNM). The fund will support 275 selected projects from more than 5,600 submissions received from students across 159 TecNM campuses, providing technical and financial backing as well as guidance for obtaining patents through the Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Intelectual (Mexican Institute of Intellectual Property, IMPI).

LFhRGUsF1SyPFLkLZSjQ.descripcion: During the APEC 2025 summit in Gyeongju, South Korea, Marcelo Ebrard proposed a regional framework for ethical AI regulation to 21 Asia-Pacific economies. Includes: ethics, cybersecurity, privacy protection. Presented 'Plan México' to attract Asian investment in Mexico's technology sector. Mexico will host APEC 2028. Implementation must be ethical, transparent, and human-centered. Proposed 4 strategic pillars: demographic exchange, cultural industries, business momentum, institutional strengthening, and digital governance.
LFhRGUsF1SyPFLkLZSjQ.resumenAgente: On October 31, 2025, during the APEC 2025 leaders' summit in Gyeongju, South Korea, Marcelo Ebrard (Secretary of Economy) presented on behalf of President Claudia Sheinbaum a proposal for a regional framework to regulate artificial intelligence. The proposal emphasizes ethical regulation, cybersecurity standards, and privacy protection. Ebrard warned that there are many risks with AI but that opportunities are more important. He presented 'Plan México' to attract Asian investment to Mexico's technology sector. He proposed 5 pillars of cooperation: demographic exchange, cultural industries, business momentum, institutional strengthening, and digital governance. Mexico will host APEC 2028. The proposal is not a binding agreement, but rather a diplomatic initiative to promote regional cooperation on AI governance among APEC's 21 economies.

Szo2Jkz805qJNLHOSTSg.descripcion: Currently under development. WIRED interview (Jan 2026) confirmed timeline: civil works in 2025, GPU procurement in 2026. Secihti reaffirmed an investment of 6 billion pesos. Scientific community celebrates the project. Projected capacity: 314 petaflops.
Szo2Jkz805qJNLHOSTSg.resumenAgente: On November 19, 2025, President Claudia Sheinbaum and the Digital Transformation and Telecommunications Agency (ATDT) announced the construction of the national Coatlicue supercomputer. This high-performance computing infrastructure is part of the national strategy for technological sovereignty and artificial intelligence development. Construction is scheduled to begin in 2026, with estimated operations starting in 2028. The Coatlicue supercomputer will be key to scientific research, national AI development, and massive data processing across various strategic sectors.

O7WKBMvjkJvk2UHtCnZI.descripcion: Presented without benchmarks, source code, or documentation.
O7WKBMvjkJvk2UHtCnZI.resumenAgente: On November 14, 2025, Saptiva in collaboration with the Secretaría de Economía (Economy Ministry) officially presented KAL, the Mexican large language model (LLM). This project represents an effort to develop national capabilities in generative artificial intelligence. However, the initial presentation was received with criticism for lacking technical benchmarks, open-source code, and detailed documentation—essential elements for assessing the model's actual performance and capabilities. KAL is currently in the development phase, and it is expected that future updates will provide greater technical transparency and comparative performance metrics with other market LLMs.

dniy0rYrEARIdwTr2dZA.titulo: Green AI Data Center with NVIDIA (Nuevo León)
dniy0rYrEARIdwTr2dZA.descripcion: Green AI Data Center in Nuevo León. Investment of ~$1,000 million USD (2026-2030) led by CIPRE Holding and AI-GDC (AI-Green Data Center), which will acquire NVIDIA technology. NVIDIA is a technology provider, NOT an investor: it publicly denied making a financial investment (12-Nov-2025). Announced by Governor Samuel García on 12-Nov-2025. High-performance computing for AI; construction starting from 2026. Highly specialized jobs (no official figures; the estimate of 10,000-15,000 is not backed by official sources).
dniy0rYrEARIdwTr2dZA.resumenAgente: On February 2, 2026, the Government of Nuevo León announced an investment of $1,000 million USD for the construction of Mexico's first AI Green Data Center, in collaboration with NVIDIA. The project, presented by Governor Samuel García from New York, will focus on high-performance computing and construction is expected to begin in 2026. It is independent of the CloudHQ project in Querétaro, differentiated by company, location, and investment amount.

tAL9KCcyZbvmDxa5By54.titulo: First Secretariat of Foreign Investment, Innovation and Artificial Intelligence - Nuevo León
tAL9KCcyZbvmDxa5By54.descripcion: Governor Samuel García announced the creation of the first Under-Secretariat of Investments, Innovation and Artificial Intelligence in the state, as part of a strategy to consolidate Nuevo León as an artificial intelligence hub in Latin America. This new institution will coordinate public policies, investment strategies, and development of specialized talent to drive the growth of the technology industry.

wHkkV1W59yQTapOx0BZ9.titulo: Installation of Google's AI Laboratory in Puebla
wHkkV1W59yQTapOx0BZ9.descripcion: Google will begin in January 2026 the installation of its first Artificial Intelligence Laboratory in Mexico, to be located in the Polo de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar Capital de la Tecnología y la Sostenibilidad (Economic Development Pole for Well-being Capital of Technology and Sustainability, SECIHTI) in San José Chiapa, Puebla. It will be Google's first laboratory of this kind anywhere in Mexico.

Ym7om7Rn8nJWhTWwOrHi.titulo: Innovation Plan 'Mexico, Country of Innovation' - Presentation in Cuernavaca
Ym7om7Rn8nJWhTWwOrHi.descripcion: President Claudia Sheinbaum's technology and economic cabinet will present the complete plan for the 'Mexico, Country of Innovation' project during the first week of December in Cuernavaca. This project includes the Laboratorio Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (National Artificial Intelligence Laboratory) as one of its four main components to create conditions for AI use by both government and private enterprise.

1Qq5rwasocMv2F0MLgQ5.titulo: Presentation of the Public Center for Artificial Intelligence Training
1Qq5rwasocMv2F0MLgQ5.descripcion: The Public Center for Artificial Intelligence Training announced by President Claudia Sheinbaum is now operational. On January 26, 2026, 10,000 students in 10 cities began activities. By February 2026, 11,000 students enrolled in specialized certified courses with Big Tech certification.
1Qq5rwasocMv2F0MLgQ5.resumenAgente:
On November 5, 2024, President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo officially presented the initiative for the Public Center for Artificial Intelligence Training, a large-scale educational project designed to democratize access to AI knowledge in Mexico. This center represents a strategic commitment by the federal government to position the country as a relevant player in the development and adoption of artificial intelligence technologies.

The project is designed to function as a major public AI school, directly linked to the SaberesMx platform, which has been conceived as an open-access digital educational ecosystem. The center's primary objective is to develop AI-trained talent, offering quality education to students nationwide, with special emphasis on democratizing opportunities for young people from historically marginalized communities lacking access to cutting-edge technological education.

The President expressed enthusiasm for this initiative, describing it as part of a much larger project to be presented in detail soon, which she called "Mexico, country of innovation" (México, país de innovación). This comprehensive vision suggests that the AI Training Center is not an isolated effort but a fundamental component of a broader national strategy to drive technological innovation and scientific development in the country.

ADyLAhTng95KSjFPUzfO.descripcion: Operating since January 2026. 11,000 students in 26 specialized courses with Microsoft, Google, IBM, Amazon, and more. First cohort active in 10 cities.
ADyLAhTng95KSjFPUzfO.resumenAgente: On October 31, 2025, the Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT, Agency for Digital Transformation and Telecommunications), in collaboration with Infotec and the Tecnológico Nacional de México (TecNM, National Technology of Mexico), announced the creation of the Public Center for AI Training. This initiative represents a government effort to democratize access to AI education and develop specialized national talent in this strategic technology. The call for applications for the first cohort was successfully closed, and classes are scheduled to begin in January 2026. The center will offer technical and specialized training programs in AI, machine learning, and related technologies, with the goal of strengthening Mexico's technological ecosystem and reducing the talent gap in artificial intelligence.

zSmTpbbyDUtKxc3bhT3a.resumenAgente: On August 31, 2025, President Claudia Sheinbaum and the Secretary of Economy (Secretario de Economía) Marcelo Ebrard announced a historic investment of $4.8 billion (approximately $4.8B USD) by CloudHQ to develop cloud infrastructure in Mexico. This investment represents one of the most significant commitments by the technology sector in the country and is part of the nearshoring strategy and strengthening of national digital infrastructure. The project involves the construction of next-generation data centers that will support cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and big data processing services. Implementation is scheduled for completion around June 2026, positioning Mexico as a regional technology hub with world-class cloud infrastructure capabilities.

ine-programa-ia-gobernanza-2025-08-20.titulo: INE: First Public Institution to Regulate AI — Programa Institucional 2025-2026 "Gobernanza y Uso Responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial" (Institutional Program 2025-2026: AI Governance and Responsible Use)
ine-programa-ia-gobernanza-2025-08-20.descripcion: On August 20, 2025, the INE's Junta General Ejecutiva (Executive General Board) approved the Lineamientos y Principios para el Desarrollo Estratégico y Uso Regulado de la Inteligencia Artificial (Guidelines and Principles for Strategic Development and Regulated Use of Artificial Intelligence), together with the Programa Institucional 2025-2026: Gobernanza y Uso Responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial (Institutional Program 2025-2026: AI Governance and Responsible Use). It makes the INE the first institution in Mexico to regulate AI institutionally. Model: auxiliary role for AI under human control, use of non-sensitive information, 6 strategic axes. Principles: legality, transparency, ethics, institutional efficiency. Public governance milestone prior to the DOF decree (Official Journal) of May 14, 2026.

fpQIXV5So7Df0Y0TYqaW.resumenAgente: On July 14, 2025, the Secretaría de Economía (Mexican Ministry of Economy) in collaboration with the Consejo Coordinador Empresarial (Business Coordinating Council, or CCE) announced the launch of the Mexico AI+ platform during a public event. This initiative was presented as an effort to drive innovation in artificial intelligence within the Mexican business sector. However, the event was characterized as largely ceremonial, without the presentation of concrete products, tools, or services associated with the platform. The lack of tangible deliverables raised questions about the practical implementation of the initiative. Future updates are expected to provide greater clarity on the specific components, functionalities, and real benefits that Mexico AI+ will offer to the country's innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem in artificial intelligence.

SLwOfsAvZBowHJ6AKkoz.titulo: AI Chatbots for 2026 World Cup - Mexico City
SLwOfsAvZBowHJ6AKkoz.descripcion: The Gobierno de la Ciudad de México (Mexico City Government) is developing multilingual AI chatbots for tourist information (lodging, dining, culture) and citizen services during the 2026 World Cup. The project involves ADIP, Secretaría de Cultura (Ministry of Culture), Secretaría de Turismo (Ministry of Tourism), SECTEI, and university academics. The chatbots will serve in multiple languages to international tourists and Mexico City residents.

UfSnLrpDhXrNnqy0BKC1.descripcion: On January 13, 2026, Sheinbaum formally announced at the mañanera (presidential morning press conference) the creation of the Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, focused on health, energy, disaster prevention, and meteorology. AIT México declared its alignment with this laboratory's objectives. Coordinated by ATDT and Secihti.
UfSnLrpDhXrNnqy0BKC1.resumenAgente: The project evolved from announcement to partial implementation. In November 2025, the Public Artificial Intelligence Training Center was inaugurated as a component of the laboratory, with facilities in 10 cities and a goal of training 25,000 graduates. No formal decree has been published in the DOF (Diario Oficial de la Federación, Official Gazette), but there are concrete advances in collaboration with UNAM, IPN, TecNM, and Infotec.
